styleSelection.reason: Trumbull College architectural elevation with crisp Gothic window recesses, sunlit ochre/sienna stone masonry courses, cool blue-violet shadow glazes, and sepia pen linework.

families.referenceCue: Clear cerulean and ultramarine sky wash with open white cloud reserves along the upper gable and roofline.
Connected cool blue-grey slate roofs and dormers with restrained pale tile variations.
Sunlit warm yellow-ochre and raw-sienna stone gable and facade planes; preserve sunlit trim and window surrounds.
Broad warm ochre and sienna stone masonry courses across the main gable and flanking wings.
Cooler shadowed left return wall, chimney, and slate-grey architectural planes separating from the sunlit gable by value.
Deeper warm-brown stone courses, green courtyard tree foliage, dark Gothic window recesses, and foreground street.
